root_policy: For an isolated replay materialize only REPLAY_SEED_AND_CLOSURE.json seed_files under a NEW root at source_relative_path. Packaged current-frame derived masks/mother/layers/contracts are comparison targets, never seed inputs. Optional audit scripts can be copied separately. Do not run in the author source tree.
registration_policy: Use saved scale/tx/ty for exact replay. register_raw.py is preserved as provenance, not an instruction to rerun the optimizer.
copy_only_root_rebase: validate_v10_geometry_union.py contains the original absolute R literal; replace that root only in an isolated working copy. The other adopted processing scripts derive R from __file__.
data_preconditions: All required actual input and guard files plus exact F043/F000 dependencies from EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.json must be present. F043 assets are reused from the earlier committed source bundle, not duplicated here.
upstream_reconstruction: Do not reconstruct prior frames or generation inputs; use exact preserved frozen files. Do not run superseded v1-v9 variants in sequence.
critical_order: First seal creates the initial a6 mother/layers. prepare_clear233 derives its 233 mask from INITIAL a6 arms and actual foreground dilated by two pixels; deriving from already-cleared final arms incorrectly yields empty. finalize_clear233 then locks the 7722 mother and fresh layers. Do not seed any current-frame outputs, including masks/contracts/frames, from the final archive.
optional_audits_note: Material measurement uses F000 plus a6; final exposure encodes/decode F043x3 then final7722x3. Neither changes adopted character or layers.
